It quantifies when inverse-curvature adaptation remains stable and distinguishes two mathematically different boundary mechanisms: a root at -1 for mild mismatch and a unit-circle pair for larger mismatch. This is useful for calibrating the source's conservative sufficient safety-factor bound.
